ward.summary: Byculla, Agripada and Mumbai Central (ward E) spent ₹63.2 lakh against a ₹53.0 lakh budget, so it is over budget at 119%. Of 118 jobs, 30% were redone within 30 days, in line with the 25% expected, though ₹20.1 lakh went on repairs that failed. The ward is flood-prone (flood index 0.70), which makes repairs harder to keep in place. Eleven jobs are listed for review. Next, the ward should fund 21 open issues costing ₹8.2 lakh, starting with Bellasis Road. With ₹0 left, none are covered, so money must be reallocated or recovered on roads under warranty.
